records.title: The Pensieve Paradigm: Stateful Language Models Mastering Their Own Context
records.reason: Pensieve/StateLM gives language models stateful context management for long-context tasks, evaluated on retrieval and reasoning. It may avoid reprocessing raw context, but the body does not establish a direct serving-cost/latency gain for the selected lineage.

records.title: MeanCache: From Instantaneous to Average Velocity for Accelerating Flow Matching Inference
records.reason: MeanCache reuses average flow velocity to skip redundant flow-matching computations and reports 3.42x–4.12x acceleration while preserving video/image quality. It is generative diffusion, not LLM inference, but caching/step-skipping is a potentially transferable adjacent optimization.

records.title: WaveFormer: Frequency-Time Decoupled Vision Modeling with Wave Equation
records.reason: WaveFormer models vision data through a frequency-time decoupled wave-equation architecture. It does not address LLM inference.

records.title: The Path Ahead for Agentic AI: Challenges and Opportunities
records.reason: The Path Ahead for Agentic AI is a broad challenges/opportunities overview. It does not add or evaluate a concrete inference optimization.

records.title: Multi-view Pyramid Transformer: Look Coarser to See Broader
records.reason: Multi-view Pyramid Transformer is a computer-vision method for coarser/broader multi-view visual representation; it offers no LLM inference-system contribution.
